historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes the critical write but omits downgrade-specific security, anti-rollback and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly converts the finite artifacts and approval into REQUIRES and protects security/configuration evidence.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 537 is the distinct F4 Save & Exit variant.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Previous version must be one exact vendor-approved image; downgrade acceptance includes post-write security and configuration state, not version alone.

original_test_intent: Downgrade the identified board to one explicitly approved previous BIOS version and prove successful write, reboot, version visibility and acceptable security/configuration health.
original_method: Verify target/current state, signed previous image and vendor downgrade/anti-rollback policy, preserve configuration/security/logs, approve one uninterrupted write/reboot with stable power and recovery, then verify BIOS Setup, OS/BMC, security and health evidence.
manual_activity: Owner approves downgrade purpose, lost-fix/security impact, image and recovery; operator supervises the vendor console/write/reboot and BIOS Setup verification. Duplicate F4 Save & Exit is excluded.
required_inputs: Exact host/board identity and current BIOS
safety_requirements: Do not execute unrelated Save & Exit
Stop on policy, signature, telemetry or health mismatch
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect BIOS Setup and OS/BMC/security evidence
engineer_actions: Ensure stable power and independent recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek states the intended downgrade but supplies no vendor command and incorrectly imports F4 from duplicate row 360. The private version-read script cannot perform or prove the downgrade.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After vendor downgrade permission, anti-rollback interpretation, exact target/image/command and recovery are approved, perform one uninterrupted downgrade and reboot, then correlate flash telemetry with BIOS Setup, OS/BMC, security and configuration evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Previous-version target, reboot, BIOS/OS checks and 20/20-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the signed previous image to board and policy, record removed fixes and anti-rollback state, preserve proof of write and verify post-downgrade security/configuration health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds downgrade permission, lost-fix impact and forward recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents a correct version string from masking an unsupported or security-regressing downgrade.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Downgrade may brick the board, trigger anti-rollback or remove required security fixes.

project_override_considerations: Project must name the exact previous release and accept its security/configuration delta; the readback Script is post-check only and F4 remains separate.
expected_evidence: Complete flash telemetry and reboot IDs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Primary fields consistently request a downgrade; the readback Script is incomplete rather than contradictory, and duplicate F4 text is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is identifiable; vendor policy, image/tool, approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Execution stops if downgrade support cannot be proven.

review_improvement: Adds anti-rollback, security-regression and forward-recovery evidence to a target-bound downgrade workflow.
independent_technical_reasoning: Downgrade is riskier than a version readback because it can be refused by policy or remove fixes even when the write completes. Exact vendor approval and recovery make it conditionally executable, so REQUIRES is more accurate than DeepSeek NO.
